samples.question: A pale field is split by three thick vertical walls into bands. A blue dot sits in the left band and a red dot in the right band. The band walls form an S-corridor in the pale field: the left wall and right wall leave a gap at the bottom, and the middle wall leaves a gap at the top if it is open. Trace the pale background and decide whether the blue dot can reach the red dot without crossing any dark wall. Are the two dots connected by the pale field? Answer with exactly one of: yes, no.
